title: Rogue One: Recon – A Star Wars 360 Experience
original_title: Rogue One: Recon – A Star Wars 360 Experience
overview: Immerse yourself in the vastness of space as an everyday X-wing pilot flying for the rebellion, with only your R4 unit and wingman by your side. What starts as a routine recon mission for Mon Mothma takes a sharp turn as you stumble upon an unexpected imperial presence—and a massive secret they will do anything to keep hidden. Created by ILMxLAB, this 360-degree immersive short film acts as a direct prequel to Rogue One: A Star Wars Story.
